summary.contract: BMW DEMO DAY2 Offline Event Service Contract (English translation)
summary.our_entity: Deruchuang Consulting Management (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. (Party A), assumed
summary.role_basis: Start2 is not named. Party A pays for and entrusts live streaming, filming and execution to Party B, a Xi'an vendor; a Shanghai consulting-management company fits a Start2 China entity (assumed).
summary.counterparty: Shaanxi Lijimei Enterprise Consulting Management Co., Ltd. (Party B)

facts.value: RMB 61,300 excl. tax; RMB 61,920 incl. tax; implied tax about 1.01%
60% = RMB 36,780 (equals 60% of 61,300, correct); due before Nov 28, 2025
Not stated (40% = RMB 24,520 on the excl-tax base)
PRC law; People's Court at Party B's location
English translation of a Chinese original

findings.issue: Party A authorised representative and contact number are blank; signature and date lines are blank.

findings.quote: Project service period: December 3, 2025 and December 4, 2024
findings.issue: Service period dates conflict by one year.
findings.action: Correct to 2025 and confirm with all stage dates.

findings.issue: Budget attachment is a title only. I.1 relies on it ("see Attachment 1").

findings.quote: Upon execution of the contract, Party A shall pay 60% of the event fee to Party B, i.e. RMB 36,780 before November 28, 2025.
findings.issue: Only the 60% prepayment amount is stated. The balance of 40% (RMB 24,520 on the excluding-tax base) has no stated amount or trigger beyond "Payment of the remaining service fee".
findings.action: State the balance amount and trigger.

findings.quote: Breaching party shall pay 20% of the total contract amount as penalty and compensate all associated losses.
findings.issue: V.3 sets a 10% penalty on Party B termination; VI sets 20% for any breach plus all losses. The regimes overlap and may stack.
findings.action: Merge into one regime with an aggregate ceiling.

findings.issue: The text is an English translation. Which version prevails is not stated and the original was not supplied.
findings.action: Obtain the original and a precedence clause.

findings.quote: Total service fee including tax: RMB 61,920
findings.issue: Implied tax is RMB 620, about 1.01% of RMB 61,300. 60% of 61,300 = 36,780 (correct). Verify tax rate and invoice type.

findings.quote: Party A may cancel event content but not the event time; Party A must bear reasonable incurred expenses.
findings.issue: "Reasonable incurred expenses" is undefined and the sentence is internally odd (cancel content, not time).
Execution is by seal and authorised representative with blank dates; no position or email.
findings.action: Adapt the standard for seal-based execution.
